meta.title: Seasons Around the World — Vocabulary Set 4
meta.subject: English Vocabulary
meta.description: Sentence completion quiz using all 16 target words from 'Seasons Around the World' in context.

questions.question: In winter, the air is freezing cold and white _______ falls from the clouds.
questions.explanation: Snow falls as soft white ice crystals in winter when it is cold.

questions.question: Some animals hibernate in winter, which means they sleep in a cave all winter.
questions.explanation: True. Hibernation is a deep winter sleep that some animals do to survive the cold.

questions.question: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, located in the _______ part of the world.
questions.explanation: Antarctica is located at the South Pole, which is in the Southern part of the world.

questions.question: The North Pole has bright, sunny days in winter when the sun never sets.
questions.explanation: False. It is dark all day at the North Pole in winter because the sun never rises.

questions.question: In spring, green leaves _______ on the trees and flowers bloom.
questions.explanation: To 'appear' means to come into sight, like new leaves appearing in spring.

questions.question: Water falls from the clouds in the sky as _______.
questions.explanation: Rain is liquid water that falls from the clouds to water the ground.

questions.question: Squirrels like to _______ nuts in tree hollows for the winter.
questions.explanation: To 'store' means to keep or save something for later use, like storing food for winter.

questions.question: Sort these words based on whether they refer to Geography or Weather/Nature:
questions.explanation: 'Northern,' 'Southern,' and 'North Pole' are geographic terms. 'Rain' and 'snow' are weather events.

questions.question: Plants will die if they do not get water or sunlight.
questions.explanation: True. Plants need water and sunlight to live. Without them, they die (stop living).

questions.question: Arrange the words to describe some places with two seasons:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'There is a dry season.' This is a season with very little rain.

questions.question: In some tropical places, there is a rainy season and a _______ season.
questions.explanation: The two seasons in tropical places are the rainy season (wet) and the dry season (no rain).

questions.question: The weather does not change much near the _______, where it is hot all year.
questions.hint: The imaginary middle line of the Earth.
questions.explanation: The equator is the line around Earth's middle where the climate stays hot and stable.

questions.question: Arrange the words to show when sunlight helps plants:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'Sunlight helps plants grow in summer.' It provides energy.

questions.question: In summer, the sun never sets in Antarctica, which is the coldest place on Earth.
questions.explanation: True. Antarctica has 24 hours of sunlight in summer, yet it remains extremely cold.

questions.question: Which of these sentences uses the word 'weather' correctly?
options: The weather today is warm and sunny.
I like to weather a coat.
questions.explanation: Weather refers to the state of the atmosphere (rain, wind, temperature), so describing it as warm and sunny is correct.
